messages:
maya (SRE): Heads up — we've got a customer report saying they didn't get pages for the last 30m. PagerDuty shows incidents but no oncall acks. Anyone seeing suppressed pages?

sam (Eng): Checking notify-bridge logs now. I see a lot of webhook 422s around the same window.

ira (Ops): Oncall manually escalated just now. We started doing manual SMS pages at 16:07 UTC. Customer saying no automated pages since ~15:35 UTC.

maya (SRE): Incident-bot shows a suppressor match: `token_scrub_v2` flagged a bunch of outgoing pager webhooks as suppressed.

sam (Eng): hmm, we rolled the header-scrub library yesterday. Can you paste the exact log lines?

ira (Ops): paste logs:
```
WARN notify-bridge: webhook_post failed id=evt-9a3f status=422 body={"error":"signature_truncated"}
ERROR ingress-proxy: header_truncate detected for header=Authorization len=2048 -> truncated
```

incident-bot: Automatic suppressor applied: rule=token_scrub_v2 reason="auth_header_malformed" action=suppress count=42

sam (Eng): looks like the auth header is getting truncated by the nginx proxy buffer after the lib update added a long signature field. That makes our signature validation fail -> suppress path kicks in. PR to fix is queued (PR #789).

maya (SRE): Ops runbook step: bypass suppressor and manually forward critical pages while we patch. Ira — can you run manual page command for the impacted incidents?

ira (Ops): Doing manual forward now: `/manual-page --to pd:oncall --reason "automated pages suppressed" --incidents 9876,9881`

ops-coordinator: Notifying CS & affected customers in #customer-communications. ETA on manual completes <5m.

sam (Eng): Hotfix plan: increase nginx `large_client_header_buffers` to avoid truncation, and revert the header-encoding change in the header-scrub lib. Will deploy to us-west2 first.

maya (SRE): Temporary mitigation applied: bumped `large_client_header_buffers 4 16k` on notify-ingress in us-west2. After restart I see PD webhook 200s again.

ira (Ops): Confirmed — PagerDuty delivered pages and oncall acks started coming in. Manual pages went out successfully. Customers notified.

sam (Eng): Deploying full revert to header-scrub lib (rolling restart). Will watch for regressions for 30m.

maya (SRE): Good job. Immediate customer impact mitigated. Next steps: postmortem, rollback the suppressor default (shouldn't be fail-open), and add an alert on suppressed_page_rate > 5/min.

ops-coordinator: I'll open the customer incident notes and update the timeline. Tagging for postmortem: `incidentbridge-header-truncation`. Assign: sam, maya.

sam (Eng): I'll open the PR and link runbook steps + the nginx config diff.

maya (SRE): Thanks — follow-up meeting Monday 09:30 PT.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: action=manual-forward performed_by=ira reason="paging missed"

maya (SRE): ack :white_check_mark:
